text.zh: 决赛点球大战，又一个『偷鸡』的机会摆在面前——尝过甜头的你……
text.en: The final shootout. Another chance to bend the rules — and you've tasted it before…

label.zh: 心理战拉满、提前半步移位，扑出制胜点球
label.en: Mind-games maxed, edge off your line, save the decisive kick

label.zh: 勺子吊射帕年卡，把全世界耍了
label.en: A Panenka — chip the lot of them

note.zh: 「帕年卡」：罚点球时轻轻一勺把球吊进球门中路、戏耍门将 —— 致敬帕年卡与皮尔洛
note.en: A 'Panenka' — softly chipping the penalty down the middle to fool the keeper — homage to Panenka & Pirlo

background.zh: 1976 年欧洲杯决赛，捷克斯洛伐克的帕年卡用轻吊点球绝杀西德，这种罚法从此以他命名；皮尔洛、托蒂都是大师。
background.en: In the 1976 Euro final Panenka chipped the winning penalty down the middle; the technique now bears his name — Pirlo and Totti mastered it too.

label.zh: 手又痒了，结果这次被 VAR 抓个正着
label.en: Your hand twitches again — VAR catches you red-handed

text.zh: 决赛点球大战，主教练问：最后一个谁来罚？
text.en: The final shootout. The manager asks: who takes the last one?

label.zh: 我来。把球稳稳放上点球点
label.en: Me. You plant the ball on the spot

label.zh: 勺子吊射帕年卡，优雅致命

note.zh: 「帕年卡」：罚点球时轻轻一勺把球吊进球门中路、戏耍门将 —— 致敬帕年卡与皮尔洛
note.en: A 'Panenka' — softly chipping the penalty down the middle to fool the keeper — homage to Panenka & Pirlo

background.zh: 1976 年欧洲杯决赛，捷克斯洛伐克的帕年卡用轻吊点球绝杀西德，这种罚法从此以他命名；皮尔洛、托蒂都是大师。
background.en: In the 1976 Euro final Panenka chipped the winning penalty down the middle; the technique now bears his name — Pirlo and Totti mastered it too.

label.en: I'll… just tie my boots first

label.zh: 大力轰向月球，球迷集体上天台
label.en: Blast it into orbit. The fans head for the rooftop.

note.zh: 把点球大力打飞冲天 —— 致敬巴乔在 1994 年世界杯决赛罚丢的那记点球
note.en: Skying the penalty into orbit — Baggio's miss in the 1994 World Cup final

background.zh: 1994 年世界杯决赛点球大战，巴乔将最后一罚打飞，意大利负于巴西，留下足坛最心碎的背影之一。
background.en: In the 1994 World Cup final shootout Baggio skied the decisive penalty; Italy lost to Brazil — one of football’s most heartbreaking images.
